text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hey, Kawakami! I'm back!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh, I've gone and mucked it up again!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see... Are you making another<n>figure for the
Princess Fighter figure<n>sculpting contest?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, but no matter how many times I<n>try, my clay
turns into a complete<n>mess...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Uh-oh, don't let yourself fall into a<n>funk!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The most important thing is<n>communicating your
feelings and<n>passion! I thought your feelings<n>toward
Princess Fighter were more<n>positive and powerful
than this!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ah! B-but of course! Princess Fighter<n>is my guiding
light—the very source of<n>my determination!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that's what I thought. If you're<n>not good at
working with clay, why<n>not try another material that
can better<n>showcase your ability?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
What an excellent proposal! I think I'll<n>try my hand
at wood carving, then!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl contacts me, saying<n>she wants to
carve wooden<n>sculptures in the academy's forest. I
manage to secure the school's<n>permission, and...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: All right, Kawakami! Let's get carving!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Very well! I'm going to turn this<n>wooden log into a
huge Princess<n>Fighter figure!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: VREEEN! TATATATA!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! The part I just shaved down<n>snapped in
half!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaah! I only wanted to chip off a<n>little, but it
completely broke off!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Aaargh! Why is wood carving so<n>difficult?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... You hacked away at it so<n>enthusiastically
that it turned out more<n>like a kokeshi doll than a
Princess<n>Fighter figure...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Urgh, you're right... This is barely a<n>step above
being a plain stick!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That said, its sharp and linear<n>silhouette does have
a certain charm<n>to it!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh... Do you really think so?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The way you carved it is like a pure<n>reflection of
your straightforward<n>feelings! Bravo!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Goodness, do you truly think so<n>highly of it?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I do! You should make use of your<n>artistic ability to
really bring out this<n>unique charm from your work!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: My word! I knew I had artistic ability<n>inside of me!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'll stay true to myself and<n>continue
hacking away in a<n>straightforward manner, then!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess continues to saw<n>away chunks
of the log until what's<n>left of her carving is one
boldly linear<n>rod!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh! Why, this...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: This looks just like the magic wandthey used in the Princess Fightermovie, Magical Love☆Princess Fighter!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's just grand! In that case,<n>you can
submit this as a replica of<n>that wand!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
All that's left is to carve out the heart<n>shape at the
end of it! Hraaah!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's complete! ☆ Not only did you<n>make great use of
the log's sheer<n>size in bringing this wand to life, the
heart at its end possesses a powerful<n>weightiness
as well! It's perfect,<n>Kawakami!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Right, let's hurry and enter it into the<n>contest!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Umm, let's see... Let me just<n>check the
contest entry page again...<n>Huh?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh nooo! This can't be!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The log-sized figure is larger than the<n>maximum
size specified for the<n>contest. As such, they're
unlikely to<n>accept her entry.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... And after all that trouble of<n>making it... How
disappointing...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, don't feel bad! There must be<n>something
we can do to share your<n>work of art.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Trainer, do you have any ideas?
choice_data_list: How about placing it in the park as a decoration?
How about posting it online as fan art?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Great idea! Let's go talk to the<n>neighborhood
association right away!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Whoa, it's huge! I wanna climb on it!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
I made it up to the big bump at the<n>top! Hehe, this is
fun!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, after displaying the log wand<n>in the park, it
becomes a popular<n>attraction for kids to climb on.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fantastic idea! We can use the magic<n>wand as a
prop and shoot a Princess<n>Fighter video! I'll play
the villain!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I-in that case, there's a special move<n>I want to try
out! I'm going to cast a<n>special magic spell, so
pretend to take<n>it head on, Pearl!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: This is the end! Give it up, DarkUmamusume Pearl! Take this!Magical☆Don't Mooove!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Argh! The weight of the wand is<n>making it
impossible for me to move!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: HYAAAH! PRINCESS IMPAAACT!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohhh nooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some days later, the video they<n>posted on online
catches everyone's<n>attention and ends up going
viral.
